snippet.title: Questprobe: The Human Torch and The Thing walkthrough (Apple II - Adventure International)
snippet.description:
The last game in the Questprobe trilogy, The Human Torch and The Thing (http://www.mobygames.com/game/questprobe-featuring-human-torch-and-the-thing) was a graphics adventure game developed by Adventure International in 1985 for the Apple ][. The player controls both The Human Torch and The Thing on a quest to rescue Alicia Masters from Doctor Doom. Hope you enjoy the walkthrough!

The long play is done by Smartadventurer, a program that I wrote to automate the playing for vintage Apple ][ games. You can follow the project here: https://vinniethelung.wordpress.com/tag/smartadventurer/

Credits:
Cover art - www.mobygames.com
Walkthrough - www.solutionarchive.com (Dorothy Millard)
